sections.title: AI Services for Seattle Healthcare Organizations

items.title: Clinical AI for UW Medicine and Seattle Health Systems
items.description: UW Medicine (University of Washington Medical Center, Harborview Medical Center, Northwest Hospital) is Seattle's academic medical anchor — a top-10 US research medical center with Epic EHR standardization and significant existing data science capacity. ClickMasters builds production AI that complements UW Medicine's research capabilities: patient risk stratification (30-day readmission, clinical deterioration, and population health risk models for UW Medicine's complex, high-acuity patient population); clinical documentation AI (ambient documentation and structured note generation for UW Medicine's physicians, reducing administrative burden); clinical research data analytics (ML on de-identified UW Medicine research datasets for predictive biomarker discovery and clinical trial cohort optimization). *Research data access at UW Medicine requires IRB approval and data use agreements — ClickMasters designs AI workflows with IRB governance as a prerequisite for research data applications.* Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | Epic FHIR integration standard.
items.label: Clinical AI

items.title: Digital Health and HealthTech AI (Seattle Startups)
items.description: Seattle's digital health ecosystem — well-funded by Amazon, Microsoft, and the broader Pacific Northwest VC community — builds patient-facing health applications, care coordination tools, and employer wellness platforms. ClickMasters builds the AI capabilities that define these products: conversational health AI for patient engagement and symptom assessment; wearable and remote monitoring ML for chronic disease management applications; care coordination AI matching patients to appropriate care pathways. *HIPAA compliance, CCPA for California-resident users, and FDA SaMD awareness for clinical-facing features are standard for Seattle digital health product AI.* Cost: $40,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks.
items.label: Digital Health

items.title: Amazon and Microsoft Healthcare AI (Tech Company Healthcare Projects)
items.description: Amazon has invested significantly in healthcare AI — Amazon Care, Alexa Health, and AWS HealthLake represent major healthcare technology investments from Seattle's largest employer. Microsoft's healthcare AI partnerships (Epic integration, Azure Health Data Services) similarly drive Seattle healthcare technology demand. ClickMasters builds healthcare AI that leverages both companies' platforms: AWS HealthLake-based FHIR data processing and ML pipelines for Amazon ecosystem healthcare projects; Azure Health Data Services integrations for Microsoft-partnered healthcare organizations; Alexa-compatible health information services built on FHIR APIs. Cost: $45,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
